scope: North wind in the coupled full Niigata district with the SWiFT actuator disk. Numerical development condition.

acceptance.numerical_reference: Strict residual, flow balance, probe and rotor-wake settling, force and matching final-field checks.
acceptance.field: On common reference-valid queries, separately in city, building wake, rotor wake and flight region: RMSE/Uref <= 0.05, P95/Uref <= 0.15, coverage >= 0.95.
acceptance.cost: At least 2x cold complete-map generation speedup against a checked same-physics reference, with matching force support and complete comparable timings.
acceptance.lookup_table_handoff: Inspect mesh sensitivity including heights and gaps before selecting the working mesh. Subsequent multi-direction CFD and whole-direction holdout evaluation precede use of a fitted wind model.

attempts.hypothesis: The existing common-mesh SIMPLEC candidate can reduce cold map cost at the cheap residual controls while preserving regional velocity and settling.
attempts.mesh_origin: Resumed the previously accepted candidate mesh. Its measured original build and mesh costs are included.
attempts.verdict: Rejected. The 4 wake probes exceeded the frozen settling limit. The compared strict reference had timed out.

subsequent_checked_reference_comparison.reason: Candidate failed the independent four-probe settling gate.

attempts.hypothesis: Smaller momentum updates could settle the residual oscillation in the original fixed-mesh strict reference.
commands: python3 scenes/joint/study.py build --common-mesh --case poc-N-reference-damped --role reference --reference-variant damped-momentum
attempts.altered_input: Only U equation relaxation changed, 0.60 to 0.45. Original and trial use the same strict outer controls, stencils and initial fields.
attempts.verdict: Rejected. The solve timed out; iteration 1000 is an incomplete log header. The iteration-900 export supports a descriptive comparison with the original provisional field.

attempts.hypothesis: The original absolute inner tolerance sometimes skipped streamwise velocity updates near the pressure floor. Tighten the transport absolute tolerance while keeping all relaxation factors and outer criteria.
attempts.altered_input: Only the absolute tolerance for the U, k and epsilon inner linear solves changed, from 1e-7 to 1e-10. Relative tolerance stayed 0.05.
attempts.verdict: Accepted as strict numerical reference for the frozen north-wind comparison. All field/force/final-sample/settling gates passed on the original mesh.

timing_uncertainty: One cold generation timing per recipe. Observed variation across different inflows does not estimate repeat-run noise.

historical_isolated_turbine.check: Recomputed wake vector errors, valid denominators, final sample iteration and cold stage time sums from the archived reference/cheap pairs. One generation timing per recipe per condition.

replay: Use the named revision and fresh run names. The first attempt resumes the historical prebuilt candidate after its mesh acceptance. Raw logs, meshes and sampled vectors are machine-local.

baseline_remeasurement.comparison: Fresh cold repeat of the unchanged baseline and a checked reference. The raw sample file is byte-identical to that of the historical baseline. All four regional field gates passed. The cold speedup missed the target.

mesh_trials.hypothesis: Coarsen the city floor volume one level while preserving the rotor wake refinement and building surfaces. Test exact source vertices before a solve.
mesh_trials.mesh_quality: Standard and custom passed; the only extended test failure was the allowed concavity diagnostic.

prepare.scope: Full source hash checks, case dictionaries, geometry transform and frozen query preparation; acquisition excluded

host-mesh-audit.scope: Host dictionary/mesh acceptance and exact support hash; excludes Docker stage already accounted

mesh_trials.verdict: Rejected before solve. The counted rotor cells and refinement level match; their vertex coordinates differ.
